question: Where is the headquarters of Geological Survey of India located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of the **Geological Survey of India (GSI)** is located in **Kolkata**.
 
• The GSI is a government organization in India, established in 1851, which is responsible for conducting geological surveys and studies.
 
• The organization plays a crucial role in the exploration and assessment of mineral resources in the country.
 
• It also provides important geoscientific information for the sustainable development of the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Geological Survey of India** operates under the Ministry of Mines and has regional offices in various parts of the country.
 
• It provides crucial data for the exploration of minerals, groundwater, and other natural resources.
 
• The GSI also conducts geotechnical investigations and natural hazard assessments to support infrastructure development and disaster management.
 
• Its contributions are vital for the economic and industrial development of India, providing a scientific basis for resource management and environmental protection.
